nodes.name: Every hour
nodes.notes: Hourly, not daily. The whole reliability model is repetition: a provider that answers half the time covers ~97% of a queue after five attempts. Daily would take five days to do what this does in five hours.

nodes.name: G2: products
nodes.notes: G2 wants 'Authorization: Token token=<key>' — NOT Bearer. A Bearer prefix 401s on every call and looks exactly like a bad key. The prefix is added here, so Config holds only the raw key. Set useG2:false if you have no token.

nodes.name: Hacker News: Show HN
nodes.notes: No credential at all. The one source here that cannot fail on auth, which is exactly why it is worth keeping even at low yield.

nodes.name: LinkFinder: decision maker
nodes.notes: Three in-request retries handle a momentary flake. Anything still unresolved goes back on the queue. If a company simply has no findable decision maker, that is a normal outcome, not an error — it is marked done and the run continues.
